★ Request
Passage of time

True, her running currently seemed to be riddled with issues. But
once past the fourth corner, she sustained a long, brilliant late spurt. What's more—

Deciding that she no longer needed watching over now that her friend had arrived,
I quietly slipped away.

Watching her run again might give me a hint on how to help her grow.
Above all, I'm worried about letting her run all by herself...

Come to think of it, they've started replanting the flower beds, you know~.
I'm sure so many lovely flowers will bloom beautifully~.

Um, do you... know this person...?
...Wait, you weren't being hassled, were you—

Huh... Isn't that Mejiro Bright?!
The next generation of the prestigious Mejiro family, following McQueen and the others...!

She fell silent once more, looking back up at the bare tree... Hesitant to just walk
away, I decided to keep watch over the lone leaf with her.
......Wheeew~.

It is swaying so gently in the breeze all by itself~.
It looks as though it might fall, yet it refuses to drop at all~...

It was on a sunny, pleasant day—one where winter's chill had begun to soften,
hinting at the arrival of spring.

...?! What a slow start...!
...And no acceleration either... Wait, are you serious?

...Th-This is... Her final spurt lacks sharpness too.
Even if she is a Mejiro... I think I'll pass~...

...So, you two are together?
...

Oh my~, is that so? Then first, we simply must have a tea party~.
One can learn so much about a person's character over a cup of black tea~.

What kind of flowers do you like, Provisional Trainer?
As for me... I love small flowers that huddle closely together.

Look, if you would please gaze at the very top of that bare tree over there.
Do you see that single leaf clinging on?

Mejiro Bright—a member of that very same distinguished family.
Though swept along by the flow, my interest was piqued, and I decided to watch her run. However—

Fufufu~... Oh, do take a look.
Even in the sky, friendly clouds are gathering together.

Before I knew it, I had agreed to oversee her training...!
But that wasn't the only surprise...

What do you think~? I would love to run in the Debut Selection Race...
So until then, I was hoping you might watch over my running~.

I do not know their names, but whenever I see them,
I feel so warm and think, 'What good friends they are~.' Fufufu~.

—Bright! There you are, I finally found you...!
...Wait, who's this?!

Fufufu~. I have registered for the upcoming race,
so I look forward to working with you until then.

The weather is simply wonderful today~.
It was another long winter this year... but spring is surely just around the corner, don't you think?

Oh dear, no response...? 
...My, are you still here with me~?

~♪
Shall we head over, then?
......Hwaaah~.

A Tracen Academy student was gazing absentmindedly at the sky.
Assuming she was just soaking up the sun, I quietly walked past, but—

...You're right, she's wearing a trainer badge.
You startled me...

Yes. I had been looking for you~.
I always believed we would meet eventually~.

And so, quite suddenly, I ended up training Mejiro Bright
for the week leading up to the Debut Selection Race...!
Yaaay~.

Hup, hup~... Oh? Provisional Trainer?
Ahhh~, I've already crossed the goal line, haven't I?
...Such a strong little one~.
Well then, I shall be off to run 1,800 meters~.

Even after that, she showed no sign of getting down to business...
Before long, her soothing, gentle presence eased my mind as well...

The Mejiro family—a prestigious lineage that has produced countless exceptional Umamusume.
Lately, not a day goes by without seeing their names in headlines for their achievements.

—Now then, before you evaluate my running...
First comes stretching, yes? To-waaah~.

—Oh, that reminds me~. Regarding my training~...
Would you be willing to oversee me starting today?

A few weeks after that encounter, I spotted her on academy grounds again.
Once more, she was daydreaming up at the sky... She really seemed to be an easygoing girl.

Swaying gently in the wind, the dead leaf looked frail enough to blow away at
any moment, yet it held on tight, refusing to fall...

A trainer...
...

...Oh, Provisional Trainer!
Good day to you~.

......Oh my, good day to you~. Please, have a seat next to me.
You can see it quite well from here~.
